policy: No normalization is represented as a literal source rule. Unresolved qualitative semantics remain visible and do not silently delete raw source formations from coverage telemetry.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Strict completed three-bar pivot: center high > both adjacent highs or center low < both adjacent lows.
BOS publishes on completed candle close beyond the relevant protected structural level; wick-only crossing does not publish BOS.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Deterministic causal break publication while keeping wick sweeps separate.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Three-candle wick gap: bullish if bar3.low > bar1.high; bearish if bar3.high < bar1.low; no minimum gap threshold.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Encode source neighboring-shadow inefficiency geometry without a hidden size filter.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: Raw candidate only: sweep a known level and close back on the pre-sweep side; exact source-valid three-candle pattern remains separately source-checked.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Preserve sweep/body-rejection opportunities without deleting source formations.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: For the source phrase 'OB body large, wicks small', require positive candle body and body length > upper-wick length and > lower-wick length. No percentage, ATR, percentile or outcome-fitted cutoff.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Encode only the qualitative ordering stated by the source while avoiding a hidden magnitude threshold. Failures are reported separately as NORMALIZATION_FAIL in coverage telemetry.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: For the source phrase 'smooth structural approach into OB', require a completed four-swing corrective M15 structure into the zone: LH/LL into a LONG OB or HH/HL into a SHORT OB. No distance, candle-body, ATR or speed threshold.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Translate the word structural literally into causal market-structure evidence without a fitted smoothness score.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: The first M15 bar that intersects the frozen OB zone and completes with its close back beyond the proximal edge in trade direction is the causal OB reaction witness used by U3 before BOS/new-POI search.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Give the source reaction->BOS->new POI sequence a deterministic event clock without retrospective best-reaction selection.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: A raw Range candidate is bounded by its causally known three-bar swing low/high pair. No width, ATR or percentage filter is added. The candidate is not source-ready until midpoint reaction, absence-of-trend evidence, deviation/reclaim, CHOCH/BOS and retest are observed.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Make the source first-high/first-low range description replayable without an outcome-fitted range-width heuristic.

frozen_initial_normalizations.definition: The minimum machine witness for source reaction at Range equilibrium is at least one completed bar whose traded interval contains 0.5 and whose close remains inside the candidate Range. No reaction magnitude threshold is used.
frozen_initial_normalizations.purpose: Provide causal evidence for the source 0.5-reaction requirement without fitting reaction size/count to outcomes.
